kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
هروا (form I)
# هَرُّوا (harrū) /har.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of هَرَّ (harra)
# هُرُّوا (hurrū) /hur.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of هَرَّ (harra) and هُرَّ (hurra)
# هِرُّوا (hirrū) /hir.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of هَرَّ (harra)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
